Specification: This specification models a minimal state machine with a single variable x whose initial and next-state values are obtained from externally defined operators Get and Get2. The module appears designed to exercise or validate user-module override behavior, since it extends a user-defined module and the TLC module and uses Print and TLCGet in a temporal property. It verifies a simple temporal specification consisting of an initial condition and a standard next-state relation, together with a liveness-style property stating that eventually the system reaches a suffix in which Print(x, x = TRUE) holds and the TLC diameter value is greater than 0.
